🔊
常用搭配
know about/of N
知道／了解……
know how to V

get to know N
逐漸認識／了解……
片語與文法
4 則
片語As sb know, ...

如某人所知，……。

片語be known to + 人

為某人或某群體所知。例：The story is known to children throughout the country.

片語be known as + 身分／名稱

以某個名稱或身分為人所知。例：The town is known as the flower capital of the region.

片語be known for + 特點／事物

因某項特色而聞名。例：The restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.

W000507

相關詞
搭配

n. / v.

love
🔊
常用搭配
fall in love with N
愛上某人或某物
love to V/Ving
喜愛做……
片語與文法
7 則
文法love to V / love V-ing

兩者通常都表示「喜愛做……」；V-ing 較強調長期喜好。例：I love reading beside the window on rainy days.

片語fall in love with + 人／事物

表示「愛上……」。例：Leo fell in love with the quiet mountain town.

片語love at first sight

表示「一見鍾情」。例：They said it was love at first sight.

片語one's love for + 人／事物

表示「某人對……的愛或喜愛」。例：Her love for animals led her to become a vet.

片語sb's love for...

某人對……的喜愛。

片語fall in love with sb

愛上某人；與某人相戀。

文法love to V = love + V-ing

喜愛做……。
